status: RECORDED BEFORE CALIBRATION OR NONLINEAR PROFILE EXECUTION
question: Can exact polynomial harmonic response be calibrated without any three-dimensional harmonic grid, and what do measured representative nonlinear costs imply for the previously infeasible grid schedule?
scope: A numerical implementation milestone and bounded cost profile. No nonlinear continuum convergence, basin justification, protein validation or quantum advantage claim.
observable: Original quartic incident contact energy averaged by fixed node degree, including all quadratic, cubic and quartic displacement terms.
coordinates: q in R^3, flat dq and mobility mu I; x_k=sqrt(beta lambda_k) q_k with exactly transformed diffusion mu lambda_k. Cell-centred reflecting faces are fixed during spacing refinement.
normalization: Exact unbounded full harmonic SD of the same quartic observable, fixed across finite grids and nonlinear profiles.
preflight: All five old harmonic and nonlinear requirements for each of three geometries and kappa=1,10,100; reconstruct the known pi-rotated congruent minimum directly from the geometry and Hessian. Report exact cells/edges/nonzeros and explicit array-byte formulas, without grid allocation.

analytic_methods: Independent degree-four Hermite expansion with Gaussian quadrature
harmonic_milestone.finite_method: Three independent 1D reversible tridiagonal generators; contract polynomial moment matrices through a tensor product. No 3D harmonic grid is allocated except the small parity test.
harmonic_milestone.case_selection: Run every named case. Report all component errors and successive comparisons. Fine levels are declared here before results; do not add levels after observing outcomes.
harmonic_milestone.positive_implementation_milestone: Both continuum analytic formulations and the tensorized-versus-full finite-grid parity meet 1e-10 for normalized static/delayed/response components; total measured harmonic stage <=60 seconds and <=512 MB worker peak. Finite-box continuum accuracy is a separate reported screen, not a prerequisite for claiming algebraic implementation correctness.
harmonic_milestone.continuum_scope: An analytic unbounded harmonic reference is obtained. Finite harmonic grid screens do not establish nonlinear coverage.

nonlinear_profile.purpose: Measure complete independent-case model preparation, equilibrium/observable construction, sparse generator assembly, all three full propagation queries and serialization; record component responses for verification, not convergence acceptance.
nonlinear_profile.primary_method: Counted scipy expm_multiply on the full CSR symmetric generator, supplied exact trace; retain all coordinates, nodes and quartic observables.
nonlinear_profile.additional_profile: Verify CSR versus a slice-based matrix-free stencil action and time ten three-column actions on each. Independently compute all three full propagation queries with a Bessel/Chebyshev recurrence on the CSR operator; no full matrix-free propagation campaign is claimed.
nonlinear_profile.independent_propagation: Use the finite symmetric generator, Gershgorin upper spectral bound, and Chebyshev expansion of exp(-tH). Bound the omitted normalized covariance contribution by 1e-9 using the Bessel generating-function Chernoff bound and actual normalized observable-vector norms. Compare all G0/K/C entries against expm_multiply at 1e-8; retain degree, bound, action counts and complete cost. Bound arithmetic is floating point, not interval certification.
nonlinear_profile.counters: Count all actual forward/adjoint vector and block calls made by matrix exponential action, including norm estimation; report vector-equivalent products and per-time query counts.

execution.seed_scope: Set before every fresh worker case, including SciPy's randomized global-state one-norm estimator. Scientific model unchanged; timings remain host-dependent.

decision: A successful harmonic implementation is a completed first milestone. Preserve failed finite-grid screens. Use actual nonlinear matvec/time/memory evidence plus declared conservative scaling estimates to propose, not execute, a feasible later allocation or a matrix-free-method validation branch. Never shrink the domain to force a pass.
